title: Delegation brief (coordinator -> spoke)
description: Written as JSON in .claude/orchestration/briefs/<brief_id>.json, then rendered with `node .claude/hooks/delegation.ts render-brief <file>`, which checks this schema plus the semantic rules (scope inside the agent's ownership, base_sha is a real commit) and prints the prompt for the Agent tool. A spoke starts with no memory: everything it needs must be in here.

agent.description: The spoke: a key of .claude/ownership.json agents.

issue.description: The GitHub issue this round works on (github.com/daveharmswebdev/chess-tutor/issues), or null for untracked work (rare: file one first).

base_sha.description: The commit the spoke starts from. Worktree spokes branch from the coordinator's HEAD, so commit contract changes before delegating.

scratch_dir.description: This spoke's own scratch directory, never a shared root.

objective.description: What to produce, specific enough that success or failure is unambiguous. Goals and quality criteria, not a step-by-step procedure.

requirements.description: Requirement IDs from docs/requirements.md this round implements. Empty for pure research or review.

contract.description: Every interface, type, schema excerpt and measured number the spoke depends on, pasted verbatim. The spoke cannot see the coordinator's context.

scope.description: Repo-relative paths or globs this round may change. Must sit inside the agent's `owns` (checked). Read-only agents: [] .

negative.description: Explicitly out of scope: other spokes' territory, forbidden actions, tempting side quests.

rubric.description: How the work is judged: tests written first, checks that must be clean, behaviours to verify.

concurrency.description: Other rounds running now and the files they touch, or null if nothing else runs.
